rows.question: Why do API requests return 429?
expected_facts: HTTP 429 indicates the Northstar gateway rate limit was exceeded

retrieved.title: API request rate limiting
retrieved.heading: Rate limit checks
retrieved.text:
API request rate limiting / Rate limit checks
HTTP 429 indicates the Northstar gateway rate limit was exceeded. Inspect the Retry-After response header and use exponential backoff with jitter. The standard tenant budget is 100 requests per minute per tenant.

Check for retry loops and duplicated jobs before requesting a budget increase. Correlate the tenant identifier with gateway counters without recording customer payloads. Clients must respect Retry-After; immediate retries extend the overload.

A synthetic record is rate_limited tenant=demo budget=100 window=60s. If traffic remains within budget but is rejected, send the gateway owner the counter timestamp and request ID. Budget changes require service owner approval and a capacity review.

retrieved.title: API latency investigation
retrieved.heading: Latency checks
retrieved.text:
API latency investigation / Latency checks
Compare Northstar API p50, p95 and p99 latency over the same five-minute window. Split latency by route and release revision. A high p95 with stable p50 suggests a subset of slow requests rather than universal failure.

Inspect database query duration, pool wait time and outbound dependency spans. Compare error rate with latency so that fast failures do not look healthy. Use synthetic trace IDs and never include customer request bodies in screenshots.

A synthetic trace is api=900ms db_wait=650ms query=40ms. This points first to connection pool waiting. Follow the database connection exhaustion runbook and validate the explanation against several traces before changing capacity.

retrieved.title: API authentication after deployment
retrieved.heading: Authentication checks
retrieved.text:
API authentication after deployment / Authentication checks
Check that the deployed Northstar API has AUTH_ISSUER=https://identity.northstar.invalid and AUTH_AUDIENCE=northstar-api. A mismatched issuer or audience causes 401 responses after deployment. Compare the active release configuration with the last healthy release. Never paste bearer tokens into an incident ticket.

Confirm that the gateway forwards the Authorization header. Compare token expiry with the API clock; Northstar permits 30 seconds of clock skew. If only new pods fail, check the mounted identity configuration and restart only after correcting it.

A synthetic log example is auth_failed reason=audience_mismatch release=r42. Record the reason, release and pod name without recording the token. Do not disable authentication to restore service. Escalate to the identity on-call if the issuer endpoint is unavailable.

retrieved.title: API unavailable responses
retrieved.heading: Availability checks
retrieved.text:
API unavailable responses / Availability checks
For HTTP 503, inspect ready endpoints behind the Northstar gateway. If there are no ready pods, check readiness probe events and the dependency health panel. Compare the first failure time with the active release.

The readiness probe uses /ready and must verify the database connection without writing data. A liveness probe must not depend on the database. When the database is down, a database-dependent liveness probe can create a restart storm.

A synthetic gateway log is upstream_unavailable service=api endpoints=0. Capture the endpoint count and rollout status. Restore healthy replicas or roll back the failing release through the approved release procedure; confirm endpoint recovery before declaring success.

Database connection exhaustion / Pool checks
Check active and idle connections in pg_stat_activity and compare them with max_connections. Northstar API uses a pool maximum of 6 connections per replica. Multiply the pool maximum by the replica count and reserve 20 database connections for operations.

Look for idle-in-transaction sessions and missing connection release paths. Record query age, application name and transaction state. Do not terminate all database sessions; ask the database on-call to review a specific stuck session.

A synthetic alert is pool_wait_ms=5000 api_replicas=12 pool_max=10 db_max=100. This configuration exceeds the connection budget. Reduce application pool demand through an approved release and check that wait time falls. Increasing max_connections requires a separate capacity review.

rows.question: How do I investigate exhausted database connections?
expected_facts: Check active and idle connections in pg_stat_activity and compare them with max_connections

retrieved.title: Database connection exhaustion
retrieved.heading: Pool checks
retrieved.text:
Database connection exhaustion / Pool checks
Check active and idle connections in pg_stat_activity and compare them with max_connections. Northstar API uses a pool maximum of 6 connections per replica. Multiply the pool maximum by the replica count and reserve 20 database connections for operations.

Look for idle-in-transaction sessions and missing connection release paths. Record query age, application name and transaction state. Do not terminate all database sessions; ask the database on-call to review a specific stuck session.

A synthetic alert is pool_wait_ms=5000 api_replicas=12 pool_max=10 db_max=100. This configuration exceeds the connection budget. Reduce application pool demand through an approved release and check that wait time falls. Increasing max_connections requires a separate capacity review.

retrieved.title: API latency investigation
retrieved.heading: Latency checks
retrieved.text:
API latency investigation / Latency checks
Compare Northstar API p50, p95 and p99 latency over the same five-minute window. Split latency by route and release revision. A high p95 with stable p50 suggests a subset of slow requests rather than universal failure.

Inspect database query duration, pool wait time and outbound dependency spans. Compare error rate with latency so that fast failures do not look healthy. Use synthetic trace IDs and never include customer request bodies in screenshots.

A synthetic trace is api=900ms db_wait=650ms query=40ms. This points first to connection pool waiting. Follow the database connection exhaustion runbook and validate the explanation against several traces before changing capacity.

retrieved.heading: Availability checks
retrieved.text:
API unavailable responses / Availability checks
For HTTP 503, inspect ready endpoints behind the Northstar gateway. If there are no ready pods, check readiness probe events and the dependency health panel. Compare the first failure time with the active release.

The readiness probe uses /ready and must verify the database connection without writing data. A liveness probe must not depend on the database. When the database is down, a database-dependent liveness probe can create a restart storm.

A synthetic gateway log is upstream_unavailable service=api endpoints=0. Capture the endpoint count and rollout status. Restore healthy replicas or roll back the failing release through the approved release procedure; confirm endpoint recovery before declaring success.

For a Northstar database deadlock, collect the deadlock log with transaction IDs and the lock wait graph. Two transactions updating tables in opposite order can create a circular wait.

Application transactions should acquire locks in a consistent table order and retry aborted transactions with bounded jitter. The database owner must review long transactions before approving query changes.

retrieved.heading: Authentication checks
retrieved.text:
API authentication after deployment / Authentication checks
Check that the deployed Northstar API has AUTH_ISSUER=https://identity.northstar.invalid and AUTH_AUDIENCE=northstar-api. A mismatched issuer or audience causes 401 responses after deployment. Compare the active release configuration with the last healthy release. Never paste bearer tokens into an incident ticket.

Confirm that the gateway forwards the Authorization header. Compare token expiry with the API clock; Northstar permits 30 seconds of clock skew. If only new pods fail, check the mounted identity configuration and restart only after correcting it.

A synthetic log example is auth_failed reason=audience_mismatch release=r42. Record the reason, release and pod name without recording the token. Do not disable authentication to restore service. Escalate to the identity on-call if the issuer endpoint is unavailable.

API authentication after deployment / Authentication checks
Check that the deployed Northstar API has AUTH_ISSUER=https://identity.northstar.invalid and AUTH_AUDIENCE=northstar-api. A mismatched issuer or audience causes 401 responses after deployment.
